title: AIS-catcher place, schema 3
description: One place as a GeoJSON Feature. The loader in Source/Tracking/PlaceCatalogue.cpp enforces these rules and a few that relate places to each other: a parent and a redirect must exist, a UN/LOCODE belongs to one port only. Keys not named here travel along unchanged.

revision.description: Raised by one on every save; a save that names an older revision is refused.

part_of.description: The place this one lies in; null says it has none.

redirect_to.description: A place replaced by another: its visits continue there.

no.description: The place's number, given on its first save and kept.

codes.description: Lists of codes by kind. unlocode is for a port only.

category.description: A label shown in place of the type, such as wind farm or strait.

rank.description: From which zoom the marker shows: 3 from 7, 2 from 9, 1 from 11, 0 from 12.

not.description: Spellings of schema 1 and 2. The loader still reads such files, as schema 3, and a save writes them in this form.
